summary.headline: Astrological Inquiries and Travel
summary.text: Continuation of a codex chapter list, covering astrological inquiries on hours, months, airs, punishment, lost objects, runaways, collapsing houses, conflagrations, migrations, fever, travel, returns, confinements, decumbitures, partnerships, sowing, garments, death, imprisonment, and slaves. It also records Theodore the Augustalis’s entry into Alexandria, works of Serapion, and a cross-reference to codex Venet. 6, folio 89, chapter 123.
